name: Reclaimers' Business in Desolace
summary: In Ironforge, Roetten Stonehammer sends recruits across the sea to meet the Reclaimers in Desolace. At Nijel's Point, Kreldig Ungor offers paid work recovering lost treasures and relics.

sections.title: A Call to the Wasteland
sections.body: Roetten Stonehammer recruits travelers in Ironforge for the Reclaimers. The group seeks profit in forgotten ruins and barren lands across Kalimdor. Desolace is a harsh stretch ruled by warring centaur clans, but the journey may pay well for those willing to make it.

sections.title: Nijel's Point and the Reclaimers
sections.body: The route runs west through the Stonetalon Mountains and into northern Desolace. Nijel's Point, an Alliance outpost, sits high among the cliffs. Kreldig Ungor welcomes new hands there. The Reclaimers recover heirlooms, magical artifacts, and family treasures lost across the war-torn world. For the right price, Kreldig and his associates retrieve those valuables from the wild.

faq.answer: Roetten Stonehammer offers paid work in Ironforge and sends you across the sea to meet his associate in Kalimdor.

aliases: how to get to nijels point
faq.answer: Nijel's Point lies in the northeastern crags of Desolace. From the Stonetalon Mountains, travel south into Desolace, then follow the cliffs east to the torchlit path that climbs to the Alliance outpost.
The Reclaimers are a venture led by dwarven operatives such as Kreldig Ungor. They recover lost heirlooms, antiquities, and magical relics from dangerous places for paying clients.
Warring centaur tribes, undead remnants, and hostile wildlife threaten travelers in Desolace, an arid wasteland beyond the Stonetalon Mountains.
Kreldig Ungor is a dwarf at Nijel's Point in Desolace. He organizes salvage work and relic hunts in the region, recruiting capable travelers to face its ruins and centaur camps.

faq.q: Is this quest required to quest in Desolace?
faq.answer: No. You can travel to Nijel's Point without Roetten Stonehammer, though he offers background and directions before you set out.

angles.text: Nijel's Point is the main Alliance sanctuary in the western wastes of central Kalimdor, surrounded by hostile centaur clans.
As a dwarf, you can find dwarven enterprise in even Kalimdor's bleakest corners, from the Explorers' Guild to independent salvage groups like the Reclaimers.
